content: {"skill": "async (b) => { const parse = (o) => { const objs = []; const re = /-\\s*(\\w[\\w ]*?)\\s*\\((\\w+)\\)\\s*at\\s*\\((\\d+),(\\d+)\\)/g; let m; while ((m = re.exec(o))) objs.push({name: m[1].trim(), type: m[2], x: +m[3], y: +m[4]}); return objs; }; const inv = async () => { const o = await b.observe(); const m = o.match(/Inventory: ([^\\n]*)/); return m ? m[1] : ''; }; const count = (s, name) => { const re = new RegExp('(\\\\d+)\\\\s+' + name, 'i'); const m = s.match(re); return m ? +m[1] : 0; }; const findObj = async (type, name) => { const o = await b.observe(); const objs = parse(o); return objs.find(e => e.type === type && (!name || e.name.toLowerCase().includes(name.toLowerCase()))) || null; }; const pick = async (name) => { for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { const s = await inv(); if (count(s, name) > 0) return true; const o = await b.observe(); const objs = parse(o); const t = objs.find(e => e.type === 'material' && e.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase()); if (!t) return false; const r = await b.walkTo(t.x, t.y, 'adjacent'); if (!r.ok) { await b.wait(200); continue; } await b.faceAndPress(t.x, t.y, 'KeyE'); await b.wait(300); } return count(await inv(), name) > 0; }; const pickKey = async (name) => { for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { const s = await inv(); if (count(s, name) > 0) return true; const o = await b.observe(); const objs = parse(o); const t = objs.find(e => e.type === 'key' && e.name.toLowerCase().includes(name.toLowerCase())); if (!t) return false; const r = await b.walkTo(t.x, t.y, 'adjacent'); if (!r.ok) { await b.wait(200); continue; } await b.faceAndPress(t.x, t.y, 'KeyE'); await b.wait(300); } return count(await inv(), name) > 0; }; const openDoor = async (name) => { const o = await b.observe(); const objs = parse(o); const d = objs.find(e => e.type === 'door' && e.name.toLowerCase().includes(name.toLowerCase())); if (!d) return true; const r = await b.walkTo(d.x, d.y, 'adjacent'); if (!r.ok) return false; await b.faceAndPress(d.x, d.y, 'KeyE'); await b.wait(300); return true; }; const craft = async () => { const wb = await findObj('bench'); if (!wb) return false; const r = await b.walkTo(wb.x, wb.y, 'adjacent'); if (!r.ok) return false; await b.faceAndPress(wb.x, wb.y, 'KeyC'); await b.wait(400); const o = await b.observe(); return /Crown/i.test(o); }; let s = await inv(); if (count(s, 'Wood') < 3) { await pick('Wood'); } s = await inv(); if (count(s, 'Stone') < 2) { await pick('Stone'); } s = await inv(); if (count(s, 'Wood') < 3) { await pickKey('Red'); await openDoor('Red'); await pick('Wood'); } s = await inv(); if (count(s, 'Stone') < 2) { await pickKey('Blue'); await openDoor('Blue'); await pick('Stone'); } s = await inv(); if (count(s, 'Wood') < 3 || count(s, 'Stone') < 2) return false; return await craft(); }", "check": "async (b) => { const o = await b.observe(); const ok = /Crown/i.test(o); return {ok, detail: ok ? 'Crown present' : 'No Crown found'}; }"}
